lyrics: Got a file on the yellowcake, a tube made of glass
cloud future that's coming on fast
from the desert to the towers of gray
You repeat the lie 'til it's the truth of the day
Got a map of the "old times," a historical claim
A phantom Nazi to   carry the blame
As NATO's dark shadow keeps creeping next
Cue the generals and experts, the twenty-four-seven feed
An embedded reporter to plant the right seed
Wave the flag on the screen 'til they can't see the red
For the black oil and profits piling   up for the dead
Now the troll farms are humming, the bots start to sow
The "whatabout" venom to help   the doubt grow
It's a multi-front battle, a   digital blitz
is blown into a million   small bits
It’s the same old product in a brand new age
Just printing new numbers on the same old page!
